description: Amazon product search with full details: title, ASIN, price, rating, review count, brand, stock, image, link. Give a query or an Amazon URL. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

country.description: Marketplace country code, e.g. US, UK, DE (default US).

query.description: Product keyword to search (provide this or url).

url.description: A direct Amazon search or product URL (provide this or query).

name: agentbit.amazon_search
title: Amazon Search (products)
